kjv: what things I have wrought in Egypt
mine: how I dealt harshly with the Egyptians
note: hit'allalti (hithpael of 'alal) means to deal ruthlessly with or make sport of someone; the KJV's neutral "wrought" loses the note of humiliating Egypt.
gevul means border or territory; "coast" in 1611 meant a border region, but now suggests the seashore (also 10:14, 10:19).
